css: .pos-wrap{max-width:360px;margin:0 auto;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#111}.pos-title{text-align:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin:0 0 4px}.pos-sub{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#555;margin-bottom:10px}.pos-line{border-top:1px dashed #999;margin:8px 0}.pos-meta{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}.pos-items{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}.pos-items th{border-bottom:1px solid #222;text-align:left;padding:4px 2px}.pos-items td{padding:4px 2px;border-bottom:1px dotted #ddd}.right{text-align:right}.pos-total{width:100%;font-size:12px;margin-top:8px}.pos-total td{padding:3px 0}.grand td{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;border-top:1px solid #222;padding-top:6px}
